name: Corviknight
description: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region’s airborne taxi service.

moves.name: Steel Wing
moves.description: The target is hit with wings of steel. This may also boost the user's Defense stat.

moves.name: Leer
moves.description: The user gives opposing Pokémon an intimidating leer that lowers their Defense stats.

moves.name: Peck
moves.description: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn to inflict damage.

moves.name: Screech
moves.description: An earsplitting screech harshly lowers the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Metal Sound
moves.description: A horrible sound like scraping metal harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.description: The user hardens its body's surface like iron, sharply boosting its Defense stat.

moves.name: Hone Claws
moves.description: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.

moves.name: Power Trip
moves.description: The user boasts its strength and attacks the target. The more the user's stats are boosted, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Fury Attack
moves.description: The user attacks by jabbing the target with a horn, a beak, or the like. This move hits two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Pluck
moves.description: The user attacks by pecking the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.description: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

moves.name: Scary Face
moves.description: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.

moves.name: Drill Peck
moves.description: A corkscrewing attack that strikes the target with a sharp beak acting as a drill.

moves.name: Swagger
moves.description: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, this also sharply boosts the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Brave Bird
moves.description: The user tucks in its wings and charges at a low altitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Fly
moves.description: The user flies up into the sky on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description: The user attacks by dropping onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Take Down
moves.description: A reckless full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply boosts its Speed stat.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special moves for five turns.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical moves for five turns.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.

moves.name: Thief
moves.description: The user attacks and steals the target's held item simultaneously. The user can't steal anything if it already holds an item.

moves.name: Curse
moves.description: A move that has different effects depending on whether the user is a Ghost type or not.

moves.name: Reversal
moves.description: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

moves.name: Spite
moves.description: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Scary Face
moves.description: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: The user randomly uses one of the moves it knows. This move can only be used while the user is asleep.

moves.name: Metal Claw
moves.description: The target is raked with steel claws. This may also boost the user's Attack stat.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type attacks. The rain also lowers the power of Fire-type attacks.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type attacks. The sunlight also lowers the power of Water-type attacks.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This move's power is doubled if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.description: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

moves.name: Fake Tears
moves.description: The user feigns crying to fluster the target. This harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Air Cutter
moves.description: The user launches razor-like wind to slash opposing Pokémon. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Metal Sound
moves.description: A horrible sound like scraping metal harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.description: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.description: The user hardens its body's surface like iron, sharply boosting its Defense stat.

moves.name: Bulk Up
moves.description: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting its Attack and Defense stats.

moves.name: Tailwind
moves.description: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that boosts the Speed stats of itself and its allies for four turns.

moves.name: U-turn
moves.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Brave Bird
moves.description: The user tucks in its wings and charges at a low altitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Nasty Plot
moves.description: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. This sharply boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Flash Cannon
moves.description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Iron Head
moves.description: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Heavy Slam
moves.description: The user slams into the target with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Hurricane
moves.description: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind. This may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Body Press
moves.description: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.

moves.name: Steel Beam
moves.description: The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its entire body. This also damages the user.

moves.name: Dual Wingbeat
moves.description: The user slams the target with its wings to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

moves.name: Tera Blast
moves.description: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

moves.name: Sand Attack
moves.description: Sand is hurled in the target's face, lowering the target's accuracy.

moves.name: Sky Attack
moves.description: The user attacks the turn after using this move. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Spite
moves.description: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.

moves.name: Rock Smash
moves.description: The user attacks with a punch. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Roost
moves.description: The user lands and rests its body. This move restores the user's HP by up to half its max HP.

moves.name: Tailwind
moves.description: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that boosts the Speed stats of itself and its allies for four turns.

moves.name: Defog
moves.description: A strong wind blows away the target's barriers such as Reflect or Light Screen. This also lowers the target's evasiveness.
